about: Where a contract and the generated bindings differed when scripts/contract-check.py arrived (FLOW-024). The check fails on a gap outside this list and on a line that is no longer a gap, so the list only shrinks (`python3 scripts/contract-check.py --shrink`). The account contract's lines are DEBT-088; the others are DEBT-096.
gaps: account: `cancel_transaction` names `CancelTransactionDTO`, which no contract defines
account: `create_fee_schedule` cannot return `AssetNotFound` (`AccountError` has no such code)
account: `create_fee_schedule` cannot return `AssetNotHeld` (`AccountError` has no such code)
account: `create_fee_schedule` cannot return `ManagementFeeOnCashAsset` (`AccountError` has no such code)
account: `get_account_details` cannot return `None` (`AccountError` has no such code)
account: `record_interest` names `RecordInterestDTO`, which no contract defines
asset: `add_asset` names `Exchange`, which no contract defines
asset: `get_supported_exchanges` names `Exchange`, which no contract defines
asset: `update_asset` names `Exchange`, which no contract defines
no contract has a row for `delete_holding_note`
no contract has a row for `get_global_performance`
no contract has a row for `upsert_holding_note`
scheduled-fetch: `configure_scheduled_fetch` takes (enabled, trigger_time); the row gives (ConfigureScheduledFetchArgs { enabled: bool, trigger_time: String })
